title: Stop Braking in the Middle of a Turn
hook: Stop slamming your brakes halfway through a turn.

script.narration: Stop slamming your brakes halfway through a turn. It is the fastest way to lose control of your vehicle.
When you brake during a turn, you shift the car's weight to the front tires. This reduces the grip on your rear tires, which can cause your car to skid or slide out, especially on wet roads.
script.visual_search: car driving on wet road POV

script.narration: The professional way to handle a curve is simple: finish your braking before you start turning the steering wheel. Once you reach the apex, accelerate gently through the exit.
